title: data/lastfm-history.json
description: The all-time scrobble count as it stood at each refresh, oldest first, one row per date and the latest 90 rows kept. Appended by .github/scripts/refresh_now.py whenever the Last.fm fetch succeeds; a second run on the same date replaces that date's row. No page reads it; it is the only record of how the count has moved, so nothing prunes it but the 90-row cap.

n.description: The all-time scrobble count on that date (lastfm.json's scrobbles at the time).
